candidate.name: Mandatory Section 508 accessibility
candidate.statement: The system shall comply with Section 508 accessibility requirements and work with screen readers, screen magnification and other assistive technology.
candidate.evidence_quote: ROBERTY: This is non-negotiable. As a public institution, we MUST comply with Section 508 accessibility requirements. The system needs to work with: - Screen readers like JAWS and NVDA - Screen magnification software like ZoomText - Other assistive technology programs We can't have blind staff members unable to run reports. The HTML output needs to be properly structured with alt tags, ARIA labels, and proper semantic HTML. And the system needs to produce standards-compliant HTML.

reason: The source explicitly makes Section 508 mandatory; the accepted paragraph must require system compliance, not merely record that stakeholders mentioned it.
